WPNSA · Osprey Quay, Portland

Weymouth & Portland

Harbour or bay? It changes everything.

Racing is either inside Portland Harbour (flat water, bendy breeze) or out in Weymouth Bay (swell, steadier pressure). Knowing which one you're in changes almost everything.
